subject.title: fix: mark empty tool-error turns non-deliverable

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this PR's `error/non_deliverable_terminal_turn` terminal-status contract for empty Codex tool-error turns now?
rationale: The code and proof support the narrow bug fix, but the status change can affect operators or downstream consumers that key off `session.ended.status`.

options.title: Accept the terminal-error contract
options.body: Land after exact-head validation, treating empty tool-error turns without delivery evidence as terminal errors.

options.title: Require compatibility mode
options.body: Ask for a legacy-compatible default or explicit strict mode before changing status semantics for existing installations.

options.title: Hold for broader recovery
options.body: Pause until guaranteed continuation or downstream channel notification behavior lands with the status change.

recommendation.title: Accept the terminal-error contract
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head validation, treating empty tool-error turns without delivery evidence as terminal errors.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Codex app-server specific and steipete has the strongest harness ownership history among the likely owners.
